decisions.reason: As a compliance-related software offer close to the core business and still shown on its own page in 2024, it remains a relatively low-cost option worth keeping while market potential continues to clarify.
Its prominent home-page presence in both 2023 and 2024 and its strong fit with the firm's hosting platform make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
A configurable managed hosting plan is a direct extension of the established offer, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests the option is performing well enough to retain.

As a newly launched security-related service that supports the firm's stated compliance and risk-reduction direction, it is sensible to keep it on the market while demand uncertainty is still resolving.
